entries.label: Animal Farm
cells: +1% Total Damage for every different species you have bred within Mob Breeding. You just need to breed the Mob type one time for it to count!

entries.label: Artifact Attraction
cells: Artifact find chance is 1.5x higher! If you've found all artifacts at max rarity, then this bonus changes to 1,000x artifact find chance!

entries.label: Certified Stamp Book
cells: All Stamps, except for MISC tab stamps, give DOUBLE the bonus.

entries.label: Depot Studies PhD
cells: All bonuses given at the Crop Depot are 1.30x higher!

entries.label: Fungi Finger Pocketer
cells: +2% extra cash from monsters for every 1 million Green Mushroom kills your account has, which can be viewed at Death Note.

entries.label: Gilded Cyclical Tubing
cells: All refinery cycles occur 3x faster. Faster cycles means more salts!

entries.label: Killer's Brightside
cells: All monster kills count for 2x more than normal for things like opening portals and Death Note. Doesn't increase resource drops or exp gain.

entries.label: My 1st Chemistry Set
cells: All Vials in Alchemy give DOUBLE the bonus. The bonus description will reflect this doubling.

entries.label: No Bubble Left Behind
cells: Every 24 hours, your 3 lowest level Alchemy Bubbles gets +1 Lv. This only applies to bubbles Lv 5 or higher, so it's more like 'your lowest level bubble that is at least level 5'. ALSO, it only works on the first 15 bubbles of each colour! Doesn't trigger on days that you don't login.

entries.label: Shrine World Tour
cells: If a shrine is placed within town, instead of in a monster map, it will act as though it is placed in EVERY map in that entire world!

entries.label: Sigils of Olden Alchemy
cells: Allows you to level up Alchemy Sigils by assigning players in alchemy, at a base rate of 1 sigil xp per hour. Sigils can be leveled up just twice: Once to unlock their bonus, and once more to boost their bonus. Their bonuses are passive, and apply to all characters always.

entries.label: Slab Sovereignty
cells: All bonuses given by the Slab are 1.25x higher!

entries.label: Spelunker Obol
cells: 1.50x higher effects from all active Jewels within the Mainframe, and gives you +50% rememberance of the game Idle Skilling. This bonus always has a 80px connection range no matter what!

entries.label: Spiritual Growth
cells: Boosts EXP multi for all three World 6 skills by +50%!

entries.label: Unadulterated Banking Fury
cells: +2% Total Damage for each 'green stack' of resources in your bank. A 'green stack' is a stack in your Storage Chest with 10 million or more items, since the number turns Green after 10M!

entries.label: Viaduct of the Gods
cells: All alchemy liquids have x5 higher max capacity. However, you regenerate alchemy liquids -30% slower.

entries.label: Viral Connection
cells: All mainframe bonuses and jewels have a 50% larger connection range, unless it states otherwise. This bonus always has a 80px connection range no matter what!

entries.label: Wired In
cells: All Uploaded Players print 2x more resources from their section of the 3D Printer. The displayed amount will NOT appear doubled, just to avoid confusion as to what your actual base Sampling Rate is, but it will be displayed in blue.

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 18 lab bonuses in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
